audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Neeko Level 1 (3/10) and Level 6 (3/10) while the why-text on those exact rows reads 'Your AA + W chop wins most level-1 exchanges' and 'Noxian Guillotine turns any 5-stack trade into a kill'. The content layer agrees with the text, not the chart.
audit.why: Darius wins 53.27% over 1224 games. Neeko has no level-1 duel and no way to survive a 5-stack Guillotine at 6 — the chart was inverted on the two stages that most define the lane.
audit.corrected: Level 1 and Level 6 flipped to Darius at 7/10, proposed as one chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike text named Neeko's ultimate 'Pop Off' and said it needs 'nearby targets to charm'.
audit.why: The ability is Pop Blossom, 120/105/90s. Riot's text: 'After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air, knocking up all nearby enemies. Upon landing, nearby enemies are damaged and stunned. The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.' There is no charm, and the prep is visible unless she is disguised — which is why the roam, not the lane, is where it lands.
audit.corrected: Real name, real cooldown, knock-up-then-stun, and the disguise-hides-the-prep rule now stated across the level-6 spike, the late block and whys[4].

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 3-5 spike told you to 'step through the minion wave to break line-of-sight on E'. Tangle-Barbs is not blocked by minions and is actively improved by them.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Neeko slings a tangle that damages and roots everything it passes through. If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.' Hiding behind the wave hands her a free upgrade instead of a block — the advice inverted the correct play.
audit.corrected: Spike rewritten: sidestep it laterally, do not use minions as cover, then pull.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block had no numbers at all.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs is 12s at rank 1 from 1000 range and Blooming Burst is 9s from 800 — her root is the only thing that stops the pull, so the punish window is the twelve seconds after she throws it. Apprehend is 26s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block and the first do now carry the real values.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe listed 'Disguise (P) and roam to set up Pop Off (R) picks' with the wrong ultimate name, and the late block repeated the charm claim.
audit.why: Same fabricated name and the same non-existent charm.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten around Inherent Glamour hiding the Pop Blossom wind-up, which is the actual hidden mechanic worth knowing here.

edits.before: Noxian Guillotine turns any 5-stack trade into a kill. The execute resets on takedowns — all-in windows are now real kill windows.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine turns any 5-stack trade into a kill, and Pop Blossom is a 120s wind-up you can simply walk out of in a 1v1.

edits.before: Neeko's only lane tool is Tangle-Barbs (E) root and Blooming Burst (Q) poke; step through the minion wave to break line-of-sight on E, then E Apprehend her in for a full bleed all-in she can't survive.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs roots through everything and grows bigger, faster and longer-rooting if it kills a unit — minions are cover for her, not you. Sidestep it laterally, then E Apprehend her in.

edits.before: Pop Off (R) needs channel time and nearby targets to charm — in a 1v1 lane you can flash-Guillotine her before the stun lands, and a reset feeds you the whole wave.
edits.after: Pop Blossom is a 120s leap that knocks up then stuns after a visible preparation — in a 1v1 walk out of it, or Guillotine her during the wind-up and reset.

edits.before: She never out-1v1s you, so this stays your lane forever — the only threat is her roaming to charm other lanes with Pop Off. Trap her in sidelane, deny recalls, and you snowball the whole map.
edits.after: She never out-1v1s you, so this stays your lane forever — the real threat is her roaming, because Inherent Glamour hides Pop Blossom's preparation entirely. Trap her in the sidelane and deny the recall.

edits.before: Level 6 you can flash-Guillotine before Pop Off's charm channel resolves.
edits.after: Level 6 you walk out of Pop Blossom's wind-up and Guillotine through it.

edits.before: Disguise (P) and roam to set up Pop Off (R) picks
edits.after: Roam disguised so Pop Blossom's wind-up stays hidden

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs: matchup-defining — Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your engage/committal tool: never waste it on chip damage. - Your ultimate: the win condition — spend it on kill windows, not on waves.
edits.after: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs: 12s at rank 1 from 1000 range — it roots through everything and upgrades if it kills a minion, so sidestep rather than hide. - Blooming Burst: 9s, 800 range, pure poke. - Darius Apprehend: 26s at rank 1 — never spend it on chip.

edits.before: Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs is 12s at rank 1 and upgrades if it kills a minion. Sidestep, then go.

notes: Fabricated ability name found: Neeko's ultimate was called 'Pop Off' in four places — it is Pop Blossom. It was also repeatedly described as a charm; Pop Blossom knocks up and then stuns, and Neeko has no charm in her kit at all. The level chart contradicted its own why-text at two stages and both are flipped here as one group. No mirror file audits/top/neeko__darius.json exists yet.
